newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel little changed against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel little changed against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel on Tuesday closed almost unchanged against the dollar in very volatile and nervous trading, dealers said.

"Trading was very volatile today. The dollar opened at 3.24 shekels from where it rose to 3.27 shekels. By midday the shekel started recovering and the dollar fell to 3.25 shekels only to rise to 3.26 shekels towards the end of the trading day," a dealer at Bank Hapoalim said.
"Investors are very nervous and there is no clear trend in the market. Investors are afraid of getting stuck at the wrong position and they do not want to take any risk," he said.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2560 shekels against 3.2550 on Monday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, closed at 3.6514 shekels against 3.6420 on Monday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8614 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8489 on Monday and against the mark at 2.1565 shekels against 2.1370 on Monday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2600 shekels.
